name: Donny Dough

features.name: LootLines
features.description: Winning lines of Multi-Dough symbols pay their combined value.

features.name: Four Multi-Dough types
features.description: Adding and multiplying, with revealing versions of each.

review:
The game that introduced LootLines. Multi-Dough symbols with Donny's grin come in four types – adding (1x–10x), revealing adding (15x–500x), multiplying (x2–x5) and revealing multiplying (x6–x25) – and a winning line of them pays their combined value.

Multiplying symbols act on everything to their left, so a line that ends on a x25 is a big moment. A gold-and-jewels game show on 5x4 with 14 lines and a 10,000x max. Danny Dollar and Donny and Danny followed.
